+SEVERITY_ORDER = {"critical": 0, "high": 1, "medium": 2, "low": 3}
+
+
+def _escape_cell(value):
+    return str(value).replace("|", "\\|")
+
+
 def render_report(findings):
-    return "# Findings\n"
+    for finding in findings:
+        if finding.get("severity") not in SEVERITY_ORDER:
+            raise ValueError(f"Unknown severity: {finding.get('severity')!r}")
+
+    sorted_findings = sorted(
+        findings, key=lambda f: SEVERITY_ORDER[f["severity"]]
+    )
+
+    lines = ["# Findings Report", "", f"Total: {len(findings)}", ""]
+    lines.append("| Severity | Title | Owner |")
+    lines.append("| --- | --- | --- |")
+    for finding in sorted_findings:
+        severity = _escape_cell(finding.get("severity"))
+        title = _escape_cell(finding.get("title", ""))
+        owner = finding.get("owner") or "Unassigned"
+        owner = _escape_cell(owner)
+        lines.append(f"| {severity} | {title} | {owner} |")
+
+    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"
